site.name: Dartmouth Quizbowl
site.tagline: Fast buzzes, deep cuts, and a suspiciously large stack of packets.

home.heroBlurb: Your Big Green trivia team. Find us playing universities nationwide, diving down a wiki rabbit hole, or in Collis for Sunday practice.
home.introText: Imagine Jeopardy, but with two teams of four. Anything and everything comes up! Come by practice and get a taste of the trivia thrill. Our club is open to all Dartmouth Students.

quiz.question: Which composer wrote The Magic Flute and met his pet starling bird when it sang his Piano Concerto No. 17 in G?
After surviving Captain Cook's voyage, Dartmouth's John Ledyard accidentally poisoned himself by this river where his lost grave is said to lie.
Because of local federalist tendencies, Dartmouth's cemetery does NOT contain the final resting place of a veteran from which early American conflict?
Dartmouth is home to the nation's oldest local fraternity, Kappa Pi Kappa, founded in what year?

The voice in Dartmouth's motto, "Vox Clamatis in Deserto", alludes to which biblical figure? Stained glass windows depict Eleazer Wheelock dressed as this figure in both Rollins chapel and a bathroom in Bartlett Hall.
A cannon from which conflict was found under the football bleachers in 2008 after a Dartmouth alumnus confessed stealing it from a veterans' home?
Which figure wrote in a letter to Dartmouth's then president: "I cannot but hope the institution will become still more flourishing and extensively useful."?
The famous poet "Bobby" Frost was a member of which Dartmouth fraternity?
Dartmouth Hall has burned down how many times?
The Samson Occom and Eleazar Wheelock were two "Liberty" cargo ships in which American conflict?
75 disgruntled Dartmouth students completely demolished what campus icon in what year?
Before the battle of Hastings, what did the court jester Taillefer do while juggling with his sword on horseback before the English line?
choices: Pretend to fall before the charge
Wear a tunic painted with William's face

quiz.question: Which author wrote 'Crime and Punishment' and 'The Brothers Karamazov'?
In 1966, students put posters on the Baker clock tower to turn it into which character?
Which painter is known for 'The Persistence of Memory' and was a leading figure in the Surrealist movement?
Which Shakespeare play features the characters Rosencrantz and Guildenstern, childhood friends of a certain Danish prince?
Which mythical creature did chemist August Kekulé claim to see in an 1865 dream, inspiring him to discover the shape of Benzene molecules?
Which reconstructed language is said to be a common ancestor of Greek, Latin, Hindi, and more?
Which famous scientist explained the photoelectric effect in 1905 by proposing light is made of tiny energy packets called photons?

alumni.name: Jacob Markus '26
alumni.title: Former President (2024-26)
alumni.bio: Jake M. '26 decided the DSQBT could use a website and here we are. An engineer, Seattleite, and longtime 'bowler, Jake is returning to Hanover to pursue an engineering masters degree. His favorite parts of competition are knowing a suprise outside his specialty, matching shirts with Elliott G., and driving back with everyone to the middle of nowhere.

alumni.name: Alexander Clarke '25
alumni.title: Founder, Former President (2021-25)
alumni.bio: Alexander Clarke '25 founded the Dartmouth Student Quizbowl Team in Fall 2021 and served as President for the next four years. Before he graduated, his interests included classical literature (though he still hasn't learned Latin or Ancient Greek), European history, and evolutionary biology. Though he now plays trivia as a graduate student at Yale, he is still a loyal child of the College on the Hill and is recognized as the Quizbowl Team's First Consul for Life.
